source_access_release.source_scope: The original Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 starts on physical page 1 and ends within shared page 56. This unchanged 69-page compilation also contains two notifications and seven later instruments.
missing_evidence: Actual text and effective date of President’s Order No. 4 of 1958.
Chapter VII commencement notification: Gazette of Pakistan, 1958 Extraordinary, page 513. A later official compilation’s footnote gives 14 March 1958, but the notification itself was not recovered.
Effect of the 1961 Repealing and Amending Order’s retrospective corrections on the original wording.
The later compilation gives an Order date of 3 December 1957; this source gives a Gazette date of 13 December 1957. No validity interval is inferred.
source_access_release.research_result: The exact Gazette pages were not located in internet searches, official KDA sources, the Ministry of Law’s current President’s Orders listing, or its search across all categories for Karachi documents from 1958. This search result does not establish that the documents do not exist.
source_access_release.source_limitations: Original scan only. The extracted text has not been fully checked against every page. Binding and fading losses may remain in the original scan. No missing words are reconstructed. This notice is a companion record, not embedded in the unchanged original PDF.
